findings.finding: Frozen candidate files and their top-level manifest pins match byte-for-byte. The 386b data file still has the pinned 6a SHA; the projection explicitly scopes itself to that data snapshot and excludes raw rules/books from its input.

The private JPEG and canonical DMG PDF hashes match the declared source identities. The eight p.175 crop files in the captured catalog set were each present, SHA-matched, and pixel-identical to their sourceCropBoundsPx cut from the private 1329x1796 JPEG. The 15 p.175/p.176/PHB asset files were present and matched catalog SHA values.

The pinned 6a current data contains exactly 11 listed Appendix C owners (owner-record JSON SHA 2534fef3f4ccf0ad5bba2351d493ef62c69cc54e4c38c317ebca1a0ec5aac83e). Six table owners have 87 rows and 87 row references: 22 use printed 175 with PDF null and supplemental image provenance; 65 use printed/PDF 176 with canonical PDF provenance. All row targets remain field-target-pending.

The exact V2 target binding file SHA 5a03485480a1cbb281e57a420d1adc6f7d134b18df50e77d0ad351cd23606d34 contains 120 bindings: 87 structured-source-reference row targets and 33 record-reference prose targets. Every binding is field-target-pending, sourceValueStatus not-assessed, and contextStatus context-not-assessed.

Projection preserves pdfPage:null, correct-edition but printing-unspecified identity, full-image privacy, the two historical context region IDs, and the separate two-crop monetary source screen. Code clones the handoff and changes only the D175 page metadata plus summary.currentSupplementalSourcePage; all other handoff fields, including the monetary question block and other-page/gap data, remain intact.

The generated coverage entry has seven valid direct links: the existing encounter procedure and the six bounded Appendix C table cards. Its description is scoped to the 11 owners/87 rows/120 pending targets and disclaims full Appendix C and DMG coverage.

The runtime validator enforces exact crop/image/region counts but not the expected p.175 region-ID set or registered region/source tuples. A mutation changing one valid p.175 ID in rules-appendix-c-character-guidance.json to `dmg175-fabricated-but-valid-prefix` was ACCEPTED; result still reported 8 crop images and 34 IDs and emitted the fabricated ID. Preserve this actual failing mutant/result. The guard should bind all 34 expected IDs and source tuples while permitting only separately documented crop hash/bounds updates for the same registered ID.

The candidate is a 0110/6a historical projection, not a current V28 render. Its pinned dist/data.json still has sources[2].coverage text saying two limited reviewed excerpts are available. The current 386b raw rules.json has since moved to generic `Limited excerpts are available`, but dist/data.json remains 6a. Source cards display sources.DMG.coverage directly. Require reassembly from current raw rules, a fresh source-card check, and a refreshed projection run before treating the user-facing preview as current.

All six candidate patches pass git apply --check against the pinned 0110 baseline. The books.js patch does not apply to the current 386b V4 books file (expected baseline-context mismatch); current V4 wording is already count-agnostic. Keep this patch baseline-scoped or omit/narrow it during V28 integration.

V1 catalog input for the left Level-of-Characters crop is still the prior 58e330 catalog with image 07fd3a... and bounds [0,1625,650,1796]. The separate fd13f5... 650x135 / proposed catalog 9c35... package is outside V1. The geometry is separately reviewed, but its catalog metadata remains a successor input; V1 does not bind or approve that updated catalog. Re-pin and rerun projection with the new catalog evidence before making a current-count claim on that catalog set.

The sealed before-state matches the actual 0110 dist/coverage-gaps.json entry. It proves the stale two-excerpt / cannot-transcribe copy. The claimed fallthrough when limitedCropsStaged becomes 8 follows from the old exact `=== 2` source condition, but was not captured as an actual old-projector execution against an 8-valued handoff; the V1 handoff-before still has 2.
